order: Record the second planning session's rulings into the plan document. Close the three deferred audit items raised during that session. The third item is adopted as a concentration-risk watch, with a proposed rotation trigger. Apply exactly four seat re-castings throughout the plan document. Recast the interactive coordinating seat as the session's own model, with a matched mirror. Its core function is direct user dialogue, and the prior casting's prose was observed degrading. The deep-work seat loses its user-dialogue duty entirely and moves to goal-directed work alone. Set the architecture seat's default, along with its ambiguous-goal and exhaustion fallbacks. Make one casting the preferred choice for bounded, fully specified orders. Outside these four re-castings, nothing changes about the never-under-specified guardrail.

The work spans three files — STATUS.md, the plan itself, and the probe runbook. It adds 134 lines and removes 76 across that small file set.
